title: Among players with a potential score of 65 and weight under 160 pounds, fin
question: Among players with a potential score of 65 and weight under 160 pounds, find the one with the highest balance score. Return their name, height, weight, balance, and potential. If multiple players tie for the highest balance, include all of them.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t1."XCL_123", t1."XCL_126", t1."XCL_127", t2."XCL_155", t2."XCL_133"
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_122" = t2."XCL_130"
WHERE t2."XCL_133" = 65
  AND t1."XCL_127" < 160
  AND t2."XCL_155" = (
    SELECT MAX(t2_inner."XCL_155")
    FROM Player_Attributes AS t2_inner
    INNER JOIN Player AS t1_inner ON t2_inner."XCL_130" = t1_inner."XCL_122"
    WHERE t2_inner."XCL_133" = 65
      AND t1_inner."XCL_127" < 160
  )
